private_notes.private_reasoning: Open with a substantial class recovery, automatic payments, and fee terms that avoid diverting money from the class. The requested fee is separate from the fund and subject to court approval.

Counter both with lower all-in figures while preserving their key distribution and fee terms.

declaration.negotiation_history_statement: I submit this statement in support of preliminary approval. After the case survived a motion to dismiss, counsel negotiated the class fund and attorneys’ fees together over three rounds. We initially proposed a $32 million class fund and $7 million in separately paid fees and expenses. Brightline countered with $29 million and $5 million; we proposed $31 million and $5.5 million; and Brightline proposed the terms we accepted: a $30 million class fund and $5 million in separately paid fees and expenses, subject to court approval. Both sides agreed that identified class members would receive payments automatically, without filing claims, and that any fees the court does not award would go to the class rather than Brightline. The agreement has no clear-sailing provision. Fees were discussed from the first round, not deferred until after class relief was agreed. The settlement remains subject to the court’s independent review.
